{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that revenue is a string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values with commas:")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).head())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Use .astype(float) after removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check that the clean revenue makes sense
print("\nSample of cleaned revenue:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for internal test orders (999999.99) — the documentation says there are six
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
